_comment: Machine-readable maturity index for the cross-language enforcement matrix. Values: proven | beta | unsafe | unavailable. Consumed by src/utils/maturity-check.ts.

java.reason: All four tools wired into L1/L2 gate; precise Viafera-equivalent rulesets

typescript.reason: Comprehensive static rules + format check wired into L1 gate

rust.reason: cargo clippy -D warnings wired into L1; pedantic deny rules in clippy.toml for hexagonal archetype

go.reason: Full linter suite (gocyclo/gosec/errcheck/staticcheck) wired into L1 gate

python.reason: Comprehensive rules (complexity/unused/security) wired into L1 gate

java.reason: pitest is the de-facto Java mutation testing standard; stable API, broad adoption

typescript.reason: Stryker 8.x is well-maintained with first-class Vitest integration

rust.reason: cargo-mutants threshold gating is unstable; passes on some versions, fails silently on others

go.reason: go-mutesting is abandoned upstream and hangs on Go 1.23 module graphs

python.reason: mutmut runtime can exceed 6h on mid-sized codebases; no reliable timeout-per-mutant control

java.reason: pact-jvm has stable consumer + provider verification; widely adopted in Spring Boot

typescript.reason: Pact JS library is well-maintained with Node 18+ support

rust.reason: pact_consumer for Rust is a community crate; provider verification is experimental

go.reason: Pact Go SDK wraps the Rust core via FFI; occasional FFI panics on newer Go runtimes

python.reason: pact-python lacks provider-verification parity with pact-jvm; V4 migration in progress

java.reason: JaCoCo is the standard Java coverage tool with Gradle and Maven integration

typescript.reason: vitest --coverage with c8 is stable and fast

rust.reason: cargo-tarpaulin produces reliable line/branch coverage on stable Rust

go.reason: Built-in Go coverage is stable; no external tooling required

python.reason: pytest-cov with coverage.py is the standard Python coverage stack

java.reason: ArchUnit has stable API and is widely used in Spring Boot monoliths

typescript.reason: eslint-plugin-boundaries provides reliable import boundary checking

rust.reason: cargo-deny and clippy provide reliable static checks for Rust

go.reason: depguard (golangci-lint) provides reliable static checks for Go, consistent with M22b pattern

python.reason: import-linter enforces import contracts; ruff handles style

java.reason: RestAssured integration tests are widely used for Spring Boot E2E

typescript.reason: Playwright is the industry standard for browser E2E testing

rust.reason: No E2E testing equivalent for Rust CLI projects; use integration level instead

go.reason: No E2E testing equivalent for Go CLI projects; use integration level instead

java.reason: OWASP DependencyCheck is the standard Java dependency audit tool

typescript.reason: npm audit is built into npm and reliable

rust.reason: cargo audit is the standard Rust advisory check

go.reason: govulncheck is the official Go vulnerability scanner from the Go team

python.reason: pip-audit is stable and maintained by PyPA
